claim: Every relaxation replacing each E4 by any two disjoint E2 equalities is feasible, with B4 and signed edges retained. This is not a source SAT witness.
checker: Rebuild signed components, check consistency, assign listed root bits, reconstruct all ports and verify every signed edge, E4 and even B parity. Apply the all-splits theorem.
root_definition: Minimum original port ID in each connected component of signed edge links and E4 equality links; bit of root itself. Unlisted roots have bit zero.
